comment: Worked out by hand: a 100 x 60 x 10 plate about the origin; hexagons of size 8 and web 2 (pitch 10) on the origin, whole cells only: the columns -5..5 at 8.660 apart, the even ones with 5 cells (y 0, ±10, ±20), the odd ones with 6 (y ±5, ±15, ±25), 61 cells of 32 sqrt(3) = 55.425626 mm2 each, cut 4 deep from the bottom: 60000 - 61 * 4 * 32 sqrt(3) = 46476.1473.
